subject: HarborBridge: Solution Proving Kit & Reference Patterns
messages:
From: Sam Murphy <sam.murphy@harborbridge.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: partner-success@harborbridge.ai
Date: 2028-01-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Solution Proving Kit v1 — sharing reference patterns

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the intro yesterday. Attached is a short 'Solution Proving Kit' we put together to make technical validation with ISV partners repeatable. The deck includes: reference deployment patterns (hosted + private), recommended test vectors, and a short checklist for success criteria.

We'd like Redwood to walk through the reference patterns and validate what you can support out-of-the-box vs what would need custom adapters (networking, auth, telemetry). Specific asks:
- Confirm expected throughput targets for a 2x-10x concurrent session workload at 8k context
- Clarify what telemetry / tracing hooks you can expose for our QA team
- Any constraints on private deployment (VPC peering, on-prem air-gapped installs)

Proposed next step: 60-min technical sync Friday (Jan 6) with your runtime/ops folks. We can run a short canary plan during the call if that's useful.

Attachment: harborbridge-reference-design-v1.pdf (pdf, 1.8MB)

—Sam Murphy
Head of Integrations
HarborBridge.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Murphy <sam.murphy@harborbridge.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-01-04T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Solution Proving Kit v1 — sharing reference patterns

Sam —

Thanks for the kit, looks helpful. Quick reads from our side: Laura (runtime lead) and Vivek (solutions/partner eng) are looped in. I'll sketch a focused scope so the sync isn't a broad architecture review. Proposed minimal proving plan:

1) Smoke validation (1hr) — confirm model variant compatibility, tokenization parity, and end-to-end latency for 2 request types (short chat, long prompt gen).
2) Scale run (2hr) — ramp to target concurrency with synthetic traffic to observe batching behavior and KV cache impact.
3) Telemetry check (30m) — validate logs/metrics export and trace correlation for prompt->token paths.

Can you share your preferred test payloads and an example dataset? Also attach any current runbooks if you have fixed failure modes documented. We've got a simple checklist we've started using for partner PoCs — attaching for your reference.

Attachments: redwood-proving-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet, 45KB)

If Friday 10:00 PST works we can do the smoke validation and schedule the scale run for a dedicated lab window next week.

—Jordan
Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Sam Murphy <sam.murphy@harborbridge.ai>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-01-05T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Solution Proving Kit v1 — sharing reference patterns

Jordan / Sam —

Thanks for sharing, Sam. A few technical notes before the sync so we can hit the ground running:

- Throughput: for 8k context our E2E latency depends heavily on batch size and requested sampling. For a 2x concurrency baseline we're expecting 40–120ms per token on our hosted infra for the quantized 8-bit variant; on Dedicated this drops ~25% depending on GPU model. We'll bring concrete perf matrices.
- Telemetry: We can export Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry spans. We will need an agreed trace key and sampling policy; HarborBridge should send a trace-id header so we can correlate.
- Private deployments: VPC peering is supported; for on-prem air-gapped installs we provide an appliance bundle but require an outbound control-plane heartbeat initially (can be disabled under NDA/legal).
- Failure cases: please provide expected SLA for long-running sessions — we need that to size KV cache and eviction heuristics.

Test cases we'd like in the proving kit: cold-start latency, token-cancellation behavior, prefix-cache hit/miss stats, and a short adversarial prompt set to validate safety filters.

I attached a concise list of the test cases we'll run during the scale window and the environment variables we need set on your side.

—Laura
Senior Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Sam Murphy <sam.murphy@harborbridge.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Erin Cole <erin.cole@harborbridge.ai>, partner-success@harborbridge.ai
Date: 2028-01-05T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Solution Proving Kit v1 — sharing reference patterns

Laura / Jordan —

Appreciate the clarity. Quick answers inline and an updated kit attached: HB team confirmed the following:

- Payloads: we attached a short corpus (10 seed prompts + 2 long-form generation scenarios) and a synthetic traffic generator script.
- Trace ID: we'll add an X-HB-Trace header per request and ship sampling policy.
- SLA: HarborBridge targets 99.5% for response completion up to 60s; we'll document expected p95/p99 for the long-run tests.
- Private install: we can provision a staging VPC for the Dedicated lab window and will provide temporary peering creds.

Attachment: hb-proving-kit-v1.1.pdf (pdf, 2.2MB)

On the Friday sync — can you cover an initial smoke run, then if green we'll follow with a dedicated lab window on Tuesday (Jan 9) for scale tests? Also happy to provide an internal operator for the canary.
